children: LAS VEGAS, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Following Aristocrat's introduction of its phenomenally popular Lightning Link™ slot brand to online casino platforms across North America, the reaction was as fast as lightning, and the launch title High Stakes™ rocketed to the top of the charts.
Now Aristocrat Interactive™, the online RMG division of Aristocrat, is expanding the Lightning Link online offering, adding the title Tiki Fire™ to the region's leading iGaming platforms.

"When we launched Lightning Link in July, we conducted a full-scale network rollout in all regulated Canadian provinces and U.S. states, supported by the industry's largest operators. We are moving with pace to expand this global icon, and the release of Tiki Fire is the next step in delivering a world-class omni-channel experience to players," Aristocrat Interactive CEO Dylan Slaney said.

Tiki Fire is part of the Lightning Link family and invites players to enjoy a thrilling Polynesian paradise. The online version of the game is a true interpretation of the player-favorite land-based version, with features that include Cash-on-Reels, bonus prizes, Hold & Spin jackpot action, free games with big symbols, and an exciting top progressive prize. During the Free Games feature, players have the chance to win a x2 multiplier on wilds.

"Worldwide, Tiki Fire is a player-favorite title in the Lightning Link family. Bringing the game online is the latest example of our ongoing commitment to delivering world-class online gaming by adapting the best content from the casino floor to regulated iGaming markets," Slaney added.

The August 2026 Eilers Fantini U.S. Online Game Performance Report & Eilers Fantini Canada Online Game Performance Report formalized the success of Lightning Link High Stakes. In Canada, Lightning Link High Stakes debuted at #1 in both the NEW Overall and NEW Slots segments. In the U.S., the title debuted at #3 in both the NEW Overall and NEW Slots segments, while impressively climbing to #4 in the Top Game Ranks – Overall (all games).
Find Tiki Fire today on your favorite iGaming app.
Aristocrat Interactive is Aristocrat Leisure Limited's (

) regulated online Real Money Gaming (RMG) business and was formed in 2024 with the combination of Anaxi and the NeoGames businesses (NeoGames, Aspire Global, BtoBet, and Pariplay). With a commitment to responsible gameplay, the business delivers land-based gaming systems, content and technology solutions for online RMG, with a full-service offering that includes content, proprietary technology platforms and a range of value-added services across iLottery, iGaming, Online Sports Betting (OSB), and Customer Experience Solutions (CXS).
